objective: Find currently open tenure-track or permanent faculty positions where an XR/HCI/Human-AI researcher can make a specific, evidence-backed application case.

United States.appointmentRule: Tenure-track or tenured faculty searches only

South Korea.appointmentRule: Permanent or tenure-track faculty appointments only

Singapore.appointmentRule: Permanent or tenure-track faculty appointments only

United Kingdom.appointmentRule: Open-ended or permanent academic appointments only

conditionalRule: HRI or Physical AI qualifies only when the posting explicitly centres human interaction, shared spatial context, augmented perception, human-agent collaboration, or an XR/HCI interface. Pure robotics, autonomy, control, sensing, manufacturing, or robot learning does not qualify.

fitLevels.Direct: The search itself explicitly names one or more direct-fit areas and the candidate's XR/HCI record maps to the requested area without relying on generic CS language.
fitLevels.Strong: The search names a closely connected area or department and the fit is supported by specific posting language plus the candidate's interaction-focused research record.
fitLevels.Broad: An open-area search accepts the candidate's rank and discipline, and a documented faculty cluster or research-area statement supports the fit. Generic open-area CS language alone is insufficient.

ranking.rule: Scores are out of 100: research fit 70, collaboration evidence 12, relevant institution strength 8, eligible rank 4, and posting-date/deadline clarity 6. An unknown or old posted date, a missing or passed review date, and a missing final deadline each receive zero for that component. Direct-fit positions remain above every possible Strong-fit position.
ranking.evidenceRule: Every collaboration or institution-strength point must be supported by a public URL. Target-venue credit is awarded only when a named, current faculty member has an evidenced ISMAR, IEEE VR, or TVCG publication and meaningful topical overlap.

sourceRule: Use an official university careers or faculty-search page as the published URL and source of truth. Aggregators may be used only to discover a search and must be cross-checked against an official source.
postingAgeRule: When an official posted date is available and is at least six calendar months old, keep the record but display an Older than 6 months — reconfirm warning. Do not infer a posted date from the discovery date, and do not close a role solely because it is old.
historyRule: Do not delete an in-scope search when it closes. Change its status to Closed and append a dated change-log event.
